title: Hire Desk Coordinator
description:
Join a busy customer operations team where no two days are the same

KMC Recruitment is working with a well-established hire business to recruit a Hire Desk Coordinator for its Ipswich operation.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, coordinating multiple tasks at once and making sure everything runs smoothly from enquiry through to delivery. You'll be part of a supportive team, acting as the first point of contact for customers while working closely with colleagues across the business to deliver a first-class service.

Whether you're already working within the hire industry or have a strong customer service background and are looking for your next challenge, we'd like to hear from you.

The Role

As part of a busy customer service and hire desk team, you'll be responsible for managing customer enquiries, arranging hires and ensuring customers receive a professional, efficient service throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to customer enquiries by telephone and email.
- Preparing quotations and processing hire orders accurately.
- Liaising with operational teams to coordinate deliveries, collections and equipment availability.
- Building strong relationships with both new and existing customers.
- Providing advice on products and services to help customers find the right solution.
- Supporting Business Development Managers with customer accounts and enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is completed correctly.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent service and resolve any issues quickly.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, hire desk, sales support or coordination role.
- Excellent communication skills, both over the phone and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Excel.
- A positive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.
- GCSE English (Grade 4/C or above), or equivalent.

Experience within the plant hire, construction, tool hire or related sectors would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,640.
- Up to 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Option to buy additional holiday and carry unused leave forward.
- Extra day's holiday for your birthday.
- Company pension with employer contribution.
- Enhanced family leave.
- Death in Service cover.
- Medicash healthcare plan.
- High street retail discounts.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Regular performance and development reviews.
- A friendly, supportive working environment with genuine opportunities to develop your career.

If you're looking for a customer-focused role where you can make a real impact while developing your career within a successful national business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Maintenance Administrator
description:
Maintenance Administrator

Ipswich, Suffolk
£14.42 an hour

Temporary assignment

Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm

A leading property maintenance and building services organisation, known for delivering high-quality work across the country, is looking for some additional help within its team. The company provides a wide range of commercial services including reactive and planned maintenance, electrical and plumbing support, and general multi-trade works.

We are seeking a confident and detail-driven Administrator to help keep daily operations running efficiently. This role sits at the heart of the maintenance team, ensuring smooth communication and supporting the coordination of ongoing works.

What you will be doing:

As a Maintenance Administrator, you will be responsible for keeping workflows organised, maintaining accurate information, and supporting the wider operational team. You'll act as a key link between engineers, clients, subcontractors, and internal departments.

Your duties will include:
- Overseeing and coordinating admin processes for both planned and reactive maintenance tasks
- Scheduling, allocating, and monitoring jobs through to completion
- Managing operatives' calendars, workloads, and appointments
- Serving as the first point of contact for clients, tenants, or residents
- Maintaining accurate systems, data, and documentation
- Providing administrative support to supervisors and managers, including reporting
- Communicating effectively with clients, internal teams, and external partners
- Identifying issues early and helping resolve them to keep service delivery on track

What We're Looking For

You'll be someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is able to juggle multiple tasks with confidence. Strong communication skills, great organisation, and a proactive approach are all essential.

To be successful, you must have:
- Previous administration experience within construction, maintenance, or a related sector
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Word, Excel, and email systems
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Strong organisation and time-management skills
- A positive, solution-focused mindset
- The ability to work independently while also being a supportive team player
- Flexibility to share the on-call responsibilities amongst the team

title: Administrator
description: We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and flexible Administrator, to join our fantastic team at Howard House Surgery in Felixstowe,with the primary focus on the role within Secretarial administration and prescriptions administration supporting with referrals and prescription requests. We are part of Suffolk Primary Care, which is a group of GP practices delivering patient care across Suffolk. The vacancy is for 3 days a week; however, this may be negotiable for the right candidate. Flexibility is crucial to accommodate training, holidays and occasional sickness. Howard House Surgery supports in excess of 8500 patients from a diverse range of backgrounds. We have an established team with a strong focus on customer service and on developing staff in order to deliver excellent standards of patient care. We use SystmOne and askmyGP to facilitate effective and efficient ways of working. You should be able to work calmly and professionally as part of a team, with the ability to multi-task. A strong command of written and spoken English with an excellent telephone manner is a must. Good time management skills and the ability to follow protocols and or instruction and attention to detail is essential. We offer a competitive salary along with other employee benefits, and the opportunity to join the NHS pension scheme. The main responsibilities of the post holder will be to ensure timely, accurate and consistent completions of referrals to secondary care, as well as accurately completing prescription requests and sending these to the appropriate pharmacy's. Working as part of a team, the post holder will be responsible for working closely with clinicians to gain the appropriate information to complete referrals and ensuring repeat medications are kept up to date and safely prescribed. They are accountable to the Administration Lead and Practice Operations Manager. Patient Administration Appointment management Results filing OOH and 111 reports filing and actions SystmOne tasks Online consultation tasks and associated actions Managing clinical correspondence, scanning & document management Shared email inboxes Care home administration Notes summarising Long term condition management Patient recalls Vaccine clinic administration Other clinic administration (LARC, minor surgery etc.) Prescription management Interpreting service bookings Medical Records Administration Patient registrations New patient checks Deduction requests Arrival of notes GP2GP transfers Sending of notes Deceased patient administration Clinical Correspondence & Reports Referrals (DXS) Medical reports, insurance requests Subject access requests Practice Administration Procurement and stock ordering Facilities and premises administration Meeting support and minute taking Rota support and locum booking administration CQC compliance and audit support Enhanced services and contractual claims and reporting

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are looking for a Part time member of staff to cover approx. 20 hours per week, with some weekend working. This is an exciting role that will include working within our reception. The role is very varied with every day being different. Your role is important to make sure that patients will be receiving the very best of care that they expect. Full support and training will be given. Prospective applicants are welcome to contact the Deputy Practice Manager, Abby Lake for an informal visit or further information. This position is not available to those that live overseas or require sponsorship to work in the UK. Good communication skills are essential.The role includes communicating with patients and colleagues, either face to face, via the telephone, sending texts, typing letters or emails. You will be Flexible and the ability to organise your time is important to the role. You will be working in our reception area dealing with patients within the surgery, with repeat prescription requests, the administration of medical reports or general queries. Scanning and clinically coding letters from other clinical settings, arranging to call patients for their regular chronic illness checks or managing our e-consultation system. You will be organised and work to efficient systems. You may be typing and organising the referrals to different organisations. You will be able to work within a team but also under your own initiative. To receive and book in patient's for Nurses and Doctors. To make appointments for patients. Answer telephone and deal with any resulting enquiries/requests. Accept and action all requests for repeat prescriptions whether requested in person, by e-mail, by fax or by post. To extract medical records for appointments, telephone messages, prescriptions etc. Complete the necessary documentation for temporary residents, immediate necessary treatment and emergency treatment. Charge and collect all private fees for non contracted work. Filing of various documents as required. Receive transport requests from patients and action them according to Surgery policy. Action on a daily basis any requests for home visits. Take messages for the District Nurses. Deal with incoming/outgoing post. Make tea/coffee for Doctors/Staff as required. Keep the reception area neat and tidy. Keep Doctors consulting rooms neat and tidy and clear of medical records and prescriptions that have been completed. Lock away prescriptions, make sure the surgery is as clear of filing as possible in the time allowed, ready for the morning staff. Set alarm if building is empty; lock doors and windows. Electronic summarising of patient medical records Scanning of documents into electronic patient records Typing letters either dictated by clinicians or under own discretion Dealing with emails/e-consultations by using strict protocols to signpost patient to the correct place. Adhere fully to the practice confidentiality and safeguarding policies. Undertake any other duties as may be determined from time to time commensurate with the job role.

Provide a friendly welcome to patients Manage the phone system, taking calls and messages and referring patients to various services using care navigation techniques Manage the online messaging service between patients and the surgery, reading and then dealing with these patient requests and queries appropriately Explain practice appointments policies (including home visit requests) and book patients appointments with appropriate clinicians using TPP SystmOne clinical software Handing completed repeat prescriptions and other correspondence to patients having checked name, address and date of birth Be able to cover all reception positions as necessary Complete Reception tasks on SystmOne such as arranging GP requested follow-up appointments for patients JOB DESCRIPTION REPORTS TO: RECEPTION MANAGER HOURS: 16-20 hours per week Job Summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, in person, over the telephone and in written correspondence e.g. online messages, to patients. Job Responsibilities: To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures To work in accordance with written protocols To read all correspondence sent to the Reception team or individually by task or email and respond as necessary To keep up to date with all mandatory training (most of this is online) Other tasks if needed (such as prescription and registration work), only with agreement and after the appropriate training is given Clear rooms after surgeries Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm Make hot or cold drinks for doctors, nurse practitioners and colleagues Any other tasks allocated by managers Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, Practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the Practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. If unsure of anything in this regard the postholder must first seek advice from the Reception Manager, the Deputy Reception Manager, the Assistant Practice Manager or the Practice Manager. Do not feel pressured to give information to someone just because they demand it. Sharing confidential information when not appropriate could constitute gross misconduct and may result in disciplinary action being taken against the postholder. Health & Safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the Practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Reporting potential risks identified Equality and Diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the Practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the Practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the Implementation of Services: The post-holder will: Apply Practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate
